facts.business: Krypton Industries Limited manufactures and sells PU-related products including tyres, rims, wheels for bicycles and hospital equipment such as wheelchairs and safety shoes for rehabilitation care industry.
key_risks: economic conditions affecting demand and supply
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions are in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards. Key managerial personnel include Managing Director Jay Singh Bardia, Whole Time Director Digvijay Singh Bardia, CEO Panna Lal Bardia, and several non-executive/independent directors.
